description: This file defines the class 'Xf' responsible for generating BIFF XF records for Excel files within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for XLS format. It manages cell and style formatting details such as colors, borders, protection, and alignment.

classes.name: Xf
classes.description: Represents an Excel XF record for cell styling, managing properties like colors, borders, protection, and alignment, and generating the corresponding BIFF record.

methods.name: writeXf
methods.description: Generates the BIFF XF record for the cell or style, encoding formatting attributes into a binary string.

methods.name: setIsStyleXf
methods.description: Sets whether this XF is a style XF or a cell XF.

methods.name: setBottomColor
methods.description: Sets the bottom border color index.

methods.name: setTopColor
methods.description: Sets the top border color index.

methods.name: setLeftColor
methods.description: Sets the left border color index.

methods.name: setRightColor
methods.description: Sets the right border color index.

methods.name: setDiagColor
methods.description: Sets the diagonal border color index.

methods.name: setNumberFormatIndex
methods.description: Sets the number format index for the cell.

methods.name: setFontIndex
methods.description: Sets the font index for the cell.

methods.name: mapTextRotation
methods.description: Maps text rotation angles to BIFF8 codes.

methods.name: mapLocked
methods.description: Maps protection lock states to BIFF codes.

methods.name: mapHidden
methods.description: Maps protection hidden states to BIFF codes.
